# Kuma Mieru 文档

- [概览](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/): 了解 Kuma Mieru 的功能，找到部署和配置的入口。
- 部署
  - [选择部署方式](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/deploy/): 比较各部署方式的支持状态和配置生效方式，选出适合你的一种。
  - [Vercel](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/deploy/vercel/): Fork 仓库，导入 Vercel，填写状态页 URL 后部署。这是推荐的部署方式。
  - [Netlify](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/deploy/netlify/): 用 Deploy 按钮或导入 Fork 的仓库，把 Kuma Mieru 部署到 Netlify。
  - [EdgeOne Pages](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/deploy/edgeone/): 把 Fork 的仓库导入 EdgeOne Pages，部署 Kuma Mieru。
  - [Cloudflare Workers](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/deploy/cloudflare/): Cloudflare Workers 部署暂不支持，本页列出仓库中保留的 Cloudflare 配置和脚本。
  - [Docker](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/deploy/docker/): 在自己的服务器上用 Docker Compose 或 docker run 运行 Kuma Mieru 的 GHCR 镜像。
  - [从源码运行](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/deploy/source/): 在本机用 Bun 和 Node.js 从源码启动开发服务器，或构建并运行生产版本。
- 配置
  - [环境变量](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/configuration/environment/): 列出 Kuma Mieru 读取的全部环境变量，以及它们的默认值和生效时机。
  - [连接 Uptime Kuma](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/configuration/uptime-kuma/): 在 Uptime Kuma 中创建状态页并设置显示时区，再把状态页 URL 交给 Kuma Mieru。
- 指南
  - [版本策略](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/guides/versioning/): 说明 Docker 镜像标签的含义、v1 的兼容范围和发布流程，帮你选择要使用的标签。
  - [常见问题](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/guides/faq/): 时间偏移、配置不生效、构建报错和 iframe 嵌入等问题的原因与处理方法。
- 开发
  - [参与开发](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/development/): 搭建本地开发环境，了解仓库结构、常用命令和提交 Pull Request 的流程。
  - [设计规范](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/zh/development/design/): 文档站的版式、颜色、组件与预览图规则，修改界面前先读这一页。

# Kuma Mieru Docs

- [Overview](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/): Learn what Kuma Mieru does and find where to start with deployment and configuration.
- Deploy
  - [Choose a Deployment Method](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/deploy/): Compare the support status of each deployment method and how configuration changes apply, then select one.
  - [Vercel](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/deploy/vercel/): Fork the repository, import it to Vercel, add the status page URL and deploy. This is the recommended method.
  - [Netlify](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/deploy/netlify/): Deploy Kuma Mieru to Netlify with the Deploy button or by importing your fork.
  - [EdgeOne Pages](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/deploy/edgeone/): Import your fork to EdgeOne Pages and deploy Kuma Mieru.
  - [Cloudflare Workers](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/deploy/cloudflare/): Cloudflare Workers deployment is not supported yet. This page lists the Cloudflare configuration and scripts in the repository.
  - [Docker](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/deploy/docker/): Run the Kuma Mieru GHCR image on your own server with Docker Compose or docker run.
  - [Run from Source](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/deploy/source/): Start a development server from source with Bun and Node.js, or build and run the production version.
- Configuration
  - [Environment Variables](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/configuration/environment/): Lists all environment variables that Kuma Mieru reads, with their defaults and when they apply.
  - [Connect Uptime Kuma](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/configuration/uptime-kuma/): Create a status page in Uptime Kuma, set the display time zone, and give the status page URL to Kuma Mieru.
- Guides
  - [Versioning](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/guides/versioning/): Explains the Docker image tags, the compatibility scope of v1 and the release process, so you can select a tag.
  - [FAQ](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/guides/faq/): Causes and fixes for time offsets, configuration changes that do not apply, build errors, iframe embedding and more.
- Development
  - [Contributing](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/development/): Set up a local development environment, and learn the repository layout, the common commands and the pull request process.
  - [Design Rules](https://alice39s.github.io/kuma-mieru/en/development/design/): Layout, colour, component and preview image rules of the docs site. Read them before you change the interface.
